## Convx 2.1.4

### Download
- **`convx-2.1.4.apk`**: one APK for every 64-bit ARM phone.

### Fixes
- Device sync stays connected with the screen off. A connection the network dropped silently (Wi-Fi power saving, a router timing out) was never noticed, so the phone vanished from the web player and the watch app until Convx was opened again. It now checks the connection every 20 seconds and reconnects on its own.
- After losing the network, or switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data, sync reconnects straight away instead of after a wait of up to a minute.
